description: Shared crash recovery cases for Kotlin (`showsSource` and `crashAllowsReload` in MinimalWebView.kt) and Swift (Recovery.swift). `source`: whether the committed `url` is the page of a `source` with this `uri`, which decides whether a crash reload or reload() loads the source again (its headers, its POST body) or the page's URL. They are equal up to trailing slashes: `/page` is `/page/`, and `https://example.com` is `https://example.com/` (the WebViews add the root path). Only that comparison: what an empty `url` (nothing committed) or an html source means is per platform. `crashGuard`: each case starts with no crashes. A crash at `at` ms reloads unless more than 3 crashes, it included, fall within the 60 s up to it, the 60 s inclusive; a crash that doesn't reload counts too. The crashes are more than 100 ms apart: Android counts the reports of one renderer death within 100 ms once.

source.name: the root path the WebView adds

crashGuard.name: the 4th crash in 60 s doesn't reload, it counts too, and older crashes leave the window
a crash exactly 60 s back counts
a crash just over 60 s back doesn't
